m: लेखा f. See below.
लेखा f. (cf. रेखा) a scratch, streak, line, stroke, stripe, furrow, ŚBr. &c., &c.
the pale or faintly discernible streak of the young moon's crescent, Kir. (cf. चन्द्र- and शशाङ्क-ल्˚), the act of delineation, drawing, painting, Śak. (v.l.)
writing, handwriting, L.
a drawing, likeness, figure, impression (cf. मृग- and सव्य-पाद-ल्˚)
the drawing of lines with fragrant substances (on the face, arms, breast &c.), L.
a hem, border, rim, edge, horizon, Kām.; VarBṛS.
the crest (= शिखा or चूडाग्र), L.
a: लेखा — [लिख्-अ टाप्] 1 A line, streak; कांतिर्भ्रुवोरायतलेखयोर्या Ku. 1. 47; Ku. 7. 16; Ki. 16. 2; Me. 44; विद्युल्लेखा, फेनलेखा, मदलेखा &c. --2 A stroke, furrow, row, stripe. --3 Writing, drawing lines, delineation, painting; पार्णिर्लेखाविधिषु नितरां बर्तते किं करोमि Māl. 1. 35. --4 The moon's crescent, a streak of the moon; लब्धोदया चांद्रमसीब लेखा Ku. 1. 25, 2. 34; Ki. 5. 44. --5 A figure, like ness, an impression, a mark; उषसि सयावकसव्यपादलेखा Ki. 5. 40. --6 Hem, border, edge, skirt. --7 The crest.

k.v: वीथ्यालिरावलिः पङ्क्तिः श्रेणी लेखास्तु राजयः। वन्या वनसमूहे स्यादङ्कुरोऽभिनवोद्भिदि॥

m: लेखा—भ्रू f. N. of a woman g. शुभ्रादि (v.l. for लेखाभ्र)
लेखाभ्र m. N. of a man (g. शुभ्रादि) pl. his descendants g. उपकादि
लेखाभ्रु See लेखा-भ्रू under लेखा.
लेखा-भ्रुम्-मन्य mfn. passing for Lekhā-bhrū, Pāṇ. vi, 3, 68, Sch.
लेखाधिकारिन् m. ‘presiding over written documents’, a king's secretary, Rājat.
लेखाक्षर n. writing (opp. to आलेख्य, painting), MW.
लेखारम्भ m. N. of a tale (= विक्रम-चरित, q.v.)

m: लेखार्ह or लेखार्˚ह्य, m. ‘fit for writing’, a kind of palm-tree (the leaves of which are used for writing on), L.
लेखा—स्थ-वृत्त mfn. conforming to prescription, Car.
लेखा—संधि m. the point where the eyebrows meet, MantraBr.; Gobh.
लेखा—वलय m. n. an encircling line, MW.
लेखा—विधि m. the act of drawing or painting, Mālatīm.
लेखाय Nom. P. ˚यति (fr. लेख or लेखा, g. कण्ड्व्-आदि), ‘to be wanton’ or ‘to waver’.

m: लेख m. (cf. रेख) a line, stroke, MānGṛ.
(also pl.) a writing, letter, manuscript, written document of any kind, Hariv.; Kāv.; VarBṛS. &c. (cf. कूट-ल्˚)
a god, deity, Śiś.
= आभोग, L.
N. of a man g. शिवादि
of a poet, Cat.
pl. N. of a class of gods under Manu Cākṣuṣa, Pur.
लेख , लेखन, लेखिन् &c. See p. 901, cols. 2, 3.
a: लेखः — [लिख्-भावे घञ्] 1 A writing, document, written document (of any kind), a letter; लेखोयं न ममेति नोत्तरमिदं मुद्रा मदीया यतः Mu. 5. 18; निर्धारितेऽर्थे लेखेन खलूक्त्वा खलु वाचिकं Śi. 2. 70; अनंगलेख Ku. 1. 7; मन्मथलेख Ś. 3. 26. --2 A god, deity. --Comp. --अक्षरं writing (opp. आलेख्य). --आधिकारिन् m. one in charge of writing letters, the secretary (of a king &c.). --अर्हः a kind of palm tree. --ऋषभः N. of Indra. --पत्रं, --पत्रिका {1} an epistle, a letter, writing in general. {2} a deed, document (legal). --संदेशः a written message. --हारः, --हारिन् m. a letter-carrier.

k.v: आदितेया दिविषदो लेखा अदितिनन्दनाः। आदित्या ऋभवोऽस्वप्ना अमर्त्या अमृतान्धसः॥

m: लेख—शाला f. a writing-school, Camp.
लेख—शालिक m. a pupil in a writing-school, ib.

m: लेख—हार or लेख—हारक, m. a letter-carrier, the bearer of a letter, Kathās.

लेख—हारि—त्व n.

s: puM, (liKatIti । liK + Rvul .) leKanakarttA । tatparyyAyaH । lipikaraH 2 akzaracanaH 3 akzaracuYcuH 4 । ityamaraH । 2 । 8 । 15 ॥ volakaH 5 karakaH 6 masIpaRyaH 7 karapraRIH 8 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ varRI 9 । iti jawADaraH ॥ * ॥ tasya lakzaRAni yaTA, -- “sarvvadeSAkzarABijYaH sarvvaSAstraviSAradaH । leKakaH kaTito rAjYaH sarvvADikaraRezu vE ॥ SIrzopetAn susaMpUrRAn samaSreRigatAn samAn । akzarAn vE liKedyastu leKakaH sa varaH smftaH ॥ upAyavAkyakuSalaH sarvvaSAstraviSAradaH । bahvarTavaktA cAlpena leKakaH syAdBfgUttama ॥ vAkyABiprAyatattvajYo deSakAlaviBAgavit । anAhAryyo nfpe Bakto leKakaH syAdBfgUttama ॥” iti mAtsye 189 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ api ca । “sakfduktagfhItArTo laGuhasto jitAkzaraH । sarvvaSAstrasamAlokI prakfzwo nAma leKakaH ॥” iti cARakyasaMgrahaH ॥ * ॥ rAjaleKakalakzaRaM yaTA, -- “brAhmaRo mantraRABijYo rAjanItiviSAradaH । nAnAlipijYo meDAvI nAnABAzAsamanvitaH ॥ mantraRAcaturo DImAn nItiSAstrArTakovidaH । sanDivigrahaBedajYo rAjakAryye vicakzaRaH ॥ sadA rAjahitAnvezI rAjasanniDisaMsTitaH । kAryyAkAryyavicArajYaH satyavAdI jitendriyaH ॥ svarUpavAdI SudDAtmA DarmmajYo rAjaDarmmavit । evamAdiguREryuktaH sa eva rAjaleKakaH ॥ nfpAnuvarttI satataM nfpaviSvAsarakzakaH । nfpaterhitakAnvezI sa eva rAjaleKakaH ॥” iti patrakOmudI ॥ * ॥ leKyakarmma kAyasTena karttavyam । yaTA, -- “leKakAnapi kAyasTAn leKyakftye vicakzaRAn ॥” kuryyAditiSezaH । iti parASarasaMhitAyAm 10 aDyAyaH ॥ (gaReSastu mahABAratasya leKakaH । yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 1 78 -- 79 । “SrutvEtat prAha viGneSo yadi me leKanI kzaRam । liKato nAvatizWeta tadA syAM leKako hyaham ॥ vyAso'pyuvAca taM devamabudDvA mA liKa kvacit । o~mityuktvA gaReSo'pi baBUva kila leKakaH ॥”)
v: pu॰ liKa--Rvul । lipikare amaraH । leKakalakzaRAdi matsyapu॰ 189 a॰ uktaM yaTA “sarvadeSa kzarABijYaH sarvaSAstraviSAradaH । leKakaH kaTito rAjYaH sarvADikaraRezu vE । SIrzopetAn susampUrRAn samaSreRigatAn samAn । akzarAn vE liKed yastu leKakaH sa varaH smftaH । upAyavAkyakuSalaH sarvaSAstraviSAradaH । bahvarTavaktA cAlpena leKakaH syAd BfgUttama! । vAkyABiprAyatattvajYo deSakAlaviBAgavit । anAhAryyo nfpe Bakto leKakaH syAd BfgUdvaha” । “sakfduktagfhItArTo laGuhasto jitAkzaraH । sarvaSAstrasamAlokI prakfzwo nAma leKakaH” cARakyaH rAjaleKakalakzaRaM tu patrakOmudyAmuktaM yaTA “brAhmaRo mantraRABijYo rAjanItiviSAradaH । nAnAlipijYo meDAvI nAnABAzAsamanvitaH । mantraRAcaturo DImAn nItiSAstrArTakovidaH । sanDivigrahaBedajYo rAjakAryye vicakzaRaH । sadA rAjYo hitAnvezI rAjasanniDisaMsTitaH । kAryyAkAryyavicArajYaH satyavAdI jitendriyaH । svarUpavAdI SudDAtmA DarmajYo rAjaDarmavit । evamAdiguREryuktaH sa eva nfpaleKakaH । nfpAnuvarttI satataM nfpaviSvAsarakzakaH । nfpaterhitakAnvezI sa eva rAjaleKakaH” । “leKakAnapi kAyasTAn leKyakftye vicakzaRAn” parASareRoktaM kAyasTasya leKakatvaM vivAdAntargatavizayaleKane eva na pustakAdO abrAhmaRaliKitapustakasya pAWanizeDAt ।
m: लेखक m. a writer, scribe, clerk, secretary, Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
one who delineates or paints, MW.
लेखक n. a writing, written message, Subh.
a calculation (˚कं √ कृ, to make a calculation, reckon), Mṛcch.
a: लेखकः — [लिख् ण्वुल्] 1 A writer, scribe, copyist. --2 A painter. --कं Writing down, transcribing. --Comp. --दोषः --प्रमादः a slip of the scribe, copyist's mistake.

m: लेखन mf(ई)n. scratching, scraping, scarifying, lancing, Suśr.
exciting, stimulating, attenuating, ib.; ŚārṅgS.; Bhpr.

लेखन n. the act of scratching or scraping, lancing, scarifying, Car.; Suśr.
touching, coming in contact (said of heavenly bodies), AV.Pariś.
writing down, transcribing, Kathās.; Pañcat.
an instrument for scraping or furrowing, Kauś.
Betula Bhojpatra (the bark of which is used for writing), L.
the leaf of the palm tree (used for the same purpose), W.
making thin, attenuating, reducing corpulency (see next).
a: लेखन — a. (नी f.) [लिख-ल्यु ल्युट् वा] 1 Writing, painting, scratching &c. --2 Exciting, stimulating. --नः A kind of reed of which pens are made. --नं 1 Writing, transcribing. --2 Scratching, scraping. --3 Grazing, touching. --4 Attenuating, making thin or emaciated. --5 Cutting or making incisions (in surgery). --6 Scripture. --7 An instrument for scraping. --8 A kind of birch-tree. --9 A palm-leaf (for writing upon). --नी 1 A pen, writing-reed, reed-pen. --2 A spoon. --Comp. --साधनं writing materials or apparatus.

लेखन—वस्ति f. a kind of enema for reducing corpulency, Suśr.; ŚārṅgS.
लेखनि See under लेखन above.
लेखनिका See चित्र-ल्˚.

a: लेखनिकः — 1 A letter-carrier. --2 One who makes another sign for himself, signing by proxy (being unable to write). --3 A writer, scribe.

s: klI, (lip + lyuw .) lepaH । lepA iti BAzA । yaTA, -- “vESAKasya site pakze tftIyAkzayasaMjYitA । tatra mAM lepayedganDalepanEratiSoBitam ॥” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥ vizRugfhalepanaPalaM yaTA, -- varAha uvAca । “SfRu tattvena me devi ! lipyamAnasya yat Palam । sarvvaM te kaTayizyAmi yaTA prApnoti mAnavaH ॥ gomayaM gfhya vE BUme mama veSmopalepayet । nyastAni tatra yAvanti padAni ca vilimpataH ॥ tAvadvarzasahasrARi divyAni divi modate । yadi dbAdaSa varzARi lipyate mama karmmasu ॥ jAyate vipule SudDe DanaDAnyasamAkule ॥ divyErnamaskfto devi ! kuSadvIpAya gacCati । kuSadvIpamanuprApya sahasraM jIvate daSa । madBaktaScEva jAyeta mahimAguRavAn SuciH ॥ kuSadvIpAt pariBrazwo mama karmmaparAyaRaH । rAjA vE jAyate suBru sarvvaDarmmezu nizWitaH ॥ lepanasya praBAveRa mama karmmaparAyaRaH । BaktyA vyavasTitaScApi sarvvaSAstrARi gacCate ॥ devi ! kArayate sarvvaM mama cAyatanAni ca ॥ kArayitvA yaTAnyAyaM mama lokAya gacCati ॥ gomayasya tu vakzyAmi tacCfRuzva vasunDare । gomayantu samAsAdya yAvalloko'nugacCati ॥ samIpe yadi vA dUre gatvAnayati gomayam । yAvanti tatpadAnyasya tAvadbarzasahasrakam । gomayAnayitA cEva svargaloke mahIyate ॥ ekAdaSasahasrARi ekAdaSaSatAni ca । tataH sa SAlmale dvIpe ramate ca mudA yutaH ॥ SAlmalAttu pariBrazwo rAjA Bavati DArmmikaH । madBaktaScEva jAyeta sarvvaDarmmavidAMvaraH ॥ aTa dvAdaSavarzARi maccittaH sudfQavrataH । vahate gomayaM suBru mama lokAya gacCati ॥” iti varAhapurARam ॥ devIgfhalepanaPalaM yaTA, -- “devyA gfhantu yaH Sukra gomayenAnulepayet । striyo vA yadi vA puMsaH zaRmAsantu nirantaram । sa laBedIpsitAn kAmAn devyA lokaYca gacCati ॥” devIpurARa 42 aDyAyaH ॥ (rAtrO lepananivaDo yaTA, -- “na rAtrO lepanaM kuryyAt SuzkamARaM na DArayet । SuzkamARamupekzeta pradehe pIqanaM prati ॥” iti maDyaKaRqe trayoviMSe'DyAye SArNgaDareRoktam ॥)
puM, (limpatyaneneti । lip + karaRe lyuw .) turuzkanAmaganDadravyam । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: na॰ lipa--lyuw । (lepA) iti KyAte 1 vyApAre । karmaRi lyuw । 2 turaskanAmaganDadravye rAjani॰ ।
m: लेपन n. the act of smearing, anointing, plastering, spreading on ĀśvGṛ.; MBh. &c.
ointment, plaster, mortar (ifc. = smeared or plastered with), Mn.; MBh. &c.
flesh, meat, L.

(ifc.) smeared or covered with, Kālid.

a: लेपिन् — a. Smearing or covering with. --m. A plasterer, bricklayer.

m: लेप्य mfn. to be smeared or anointed or stained or defiled, MaitrUp.
moulded, modelled, BhP.

m: लेप्य—कार (Hcar.) m. one who makes moulds or models, a bricklayer, plasterer.

m: लेप्य—कृत् (L.) m. one who makes moulds or models, a bricklayer, plasterer.
